title: Zero-deficit coefficient completion and exact full-B2 certificate thresholds

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. claims: For every integer k>r+1 and2<=t<r, with weights2,...,r+1, Section12 proves a nonzero full-weight coefficient when t selected blocks have nonnegative deficits and their positive subset satisfies sum_positive deficits+max_positive dimension>k+1. H+E0 is exactly the largest dimension failing THIS enlarged selection predicate. No optimality of actual circuits or other field arguments is claimed.

The complete searches give (L_old,L_weighted,L_positive-exact,L_N)=(1461,1437,1429,1413) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521) at N=10000. These compare certified losses, not actual circuit sizes; the new selected loss never exceeds each reference when it exists.

experiments.purpose: Bounded exhaustive failed-dimension maxima and attaining vectors for zero-deficit completion, independent finite reference searches, zero-deficit matrix ranks, retained marked distributions, field prefixes and evaluator predicates. Universal correctness rests on the written proofs.
